verdict.rationale: Temporal ships an embedded local development service (`temporal server start-dev`). It starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your own machine, giving a sandbox fully separate from production clusters. Namespace isolation adds a further way to separate test and production environments. missing for 10: explicit docs on testing frameworks (e.g. test environments or replay testing), guidance on keeping test data out of production namespaces, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox workflows for AI or agent use.
